positions.name: ReviewerEnrollmentAssertionProbe
positions.frame: what is this probe memory for, and what does the e2e suite verify when it asserts that saving a memory enrolls the creator as reviewer?
positions.why: src-1 states the enrollment rule the e2e suite asserts; src-2 explicitly frames the memory itself as existing only to carry that assertion, tying the two into one instrumental read — a test artifact whose sole content is the rule it demonstrates. Both dimensional passes independently converged the two segments onto shared mints (InstrumentalProbeRegister in register, ActionEnrollsActorAsReviewer in relational), reinforcing that they cohere under a single directional read: this pair is read together as a self-declared test probe for the reviewer-enrollment behavior, not as two independent claims.
